insert-image-into-pdf-using-pdffilemend.title: Insert Image into PDF using PdfFileMend
insert-image-into-pdf-using-pdffilemend.description: Demonstrates how to bind an existing PDF, insert an image onto a specific page using PdfFileMend, and save the modified document.

replace-image-in-pdf.title: Replace Image in PDF using PdfContentEditor
replace-image-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to load a PDF with PdfContentEditor, replace an existing image on a page, and save the modified document.

insert-multiple-images-into-pdf.title: Insert Multiple Images into PDF Using PdfFileMend
insert-multiple-images-into-pdf.description: Shows how to bind an existing PDF, add images to specific pages at defined coordinates, and save the modified document using Aspose.Pdf's PdfFileMend facade.

replace-images-in-pdf.title: Replace Images in PDF with PdfContentEditor
replace-images-in-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind an existing PDF, replace specific images on given pages using PdfContentEditor, and save the result as a new file.

add-jpg-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add JPG Image to Specific PDF Page Using PdfFileMend
add-jpg-image-to-pdf-page.description: Shows how to bind an existing PDF with PdfFileMend, insert a JPG image onto page two at given coordinates, and save the updated PDF.

add-png-image-to-first-page-pdf.title: Add PNG Image to First Page of PDF using PdfFileMend

overlay-gif-on-png-background-pdf.title: Overlay GIF on PNG Background in PDF using PdfFileMend
overlay-gif-on-png-background-pdf.description: Demonstrates how to bind an existing PDF, add a PNG as a background on page three, and overlay a GIF image using compositing parameters, then save the result.

replace-bmp-image-with-jpg-on-pdf-page.title: Replace BMP Image on PDF Page with JPG

remove-image-from-pdf-page__v2.title: Remove Image from Specific PDF Page Using PdfContentEditor

extract-images-from-pdf__v16.title: Extract Images from PDF using PdfExtractor

add-image-and-caption-to-pdf-page.title: Add Image and Caption to Specific PDF Page

add-multiple-images-to-pdf-pages.title: Add Multiple Images to Specific PDF Pages using PdfFileMend

extract-images-pdf-csv-manifest__v2.title: Extract PDF Images and Generate CSV Manifest with PdfFileMend

add-bmp-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add BMP Image to Specific PDF Page using PdfFileMend

add-gif-image-to-pdf-page.title: Add GIF Image to Specific PDF Page using PdfFileMend
